old_caption: The video begins with a view of a room featuring a ceiling-mounted chandelier with four illuminated light bulbs. The chandelier is ornate, with a metallic finish and decorative elements. The walls are adorned with patterned wallpaper, and there are framed pictures hanging on them. A dark wooden cabinet is visible to the right, holding various items. The camera remains mostly static with slight, subtle movements, capturing the chandelier from different angles and highlighting its intricate design and the warm glow it casts over the room.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a view of a room featuring a ceiling-mounted chandelier with four light bulbs, all illuminated. The chandelier is ornate, with a metallic finish and decorative elements. The walls are adorned with patterned wallpaper, and there are framed pictures hanging on them. To the right, a dark wooden cabinet holds various items, including a statue of an owl perched atop it. The camera pans to the left, revealing more of the room's interior, including a wooden door and additional framed pictures on the wall. As the camera continues to pan, it captures the chandelier from different angles, highlighting its intricate design and the warm glow it casts over the room. The video concludes with a full view of the chandelier, emphasizing its elegant structure and the cozy ambiance it creates in the space.
caption: A lit three-arm chandelier with frosted white glass shades hangs from a metal ceiling canopy by a short chain, suspended above an interior room corner. The walls wear mauve wallpaper patterned with pale leaf lines, and a small framed portrait is mounted on the wall behind the fixture. The top edge of a wooden door sits at lower left while a dark wooden cabinet stands at right. The camera drifts slowly, carrying the portrait, the door, the cabinet and the ceiling line steadily toward the right and downward across the frame. As this sweep continues, a framed photo collage on the left wall slides into view at the frame's edge. The chandelier's shades shift and tilt relative to the fixed canopy, suggesting a gentle sway of the fixture, while its three bulbs stay illuminated throughout. No person or other moving object enters the scene.
